messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate on tool/function invocations and a spike in structured-output processing latency across hosts in eu-west-1. 90th token latency up 6x. Paging oncall.

mika (oncall): saw this, joining. any customer-facing impact yet? what metrics are we using to decide mitigation? :eyes:

sam: errors look like 502s from the fn-proxy when tool calls have large json payloads. CPU and GPU time both higher than usual. Traffic is mainly bursty chat completions with function calls enabled.

jess: customer success flagged two customers reporting slow streaming and partial json truncation. they included logs with repeated "toolcall-timeout" entries.

ryan (eng-sre): investigating host-level. kernel-level queuing for the worker processes. I see continuous batching causing long-lived locks when structured_output size > ~100KB. Might be memory pressure from large tool responses.

mika (oncall): we need quick mitigation. priority: keep hosted API usable, avoid full outage. propose: 1) throttle function/tool calls for public tier; 2) temporarily disable structured_output streaming for non-enterprise tenants; 3) enable fallback to plain text for tool responses if JSON parsing fails. Thoughts?

sam: +1 on throttling. suggest rate-limit by tenant with a fast toggle. we can push a config change to the routing layer now. command to run:
```
# increase fncall backoff multiplier for public tier
routectl set-key routing.fncall_backoff_multiplier --value=4 --scope=public
```

jess: for structured output, do we have a flag? can we flip it per-customer?

ryan (eng-sre): yes, we have feature flags. two safe toggles:
```
featurectl disable structured_output_streaming --scope=public
featurectl set fallback_tool_response_format=text --scope=public
```
These are hot-config; no deploy needed.

mika (oncall): ok, let's run both. sam, take routing change. ry an, flip structured_output flag. jess, coordinate CS comms with a short note about degraded JSON streaming and recommend customers reduce tool response sizes or pin to enterprise for uninterrupted structured output.

sam: running routing change now. `routectl apply ...` — returned: accepted, change id 9923. will monitor.

ryan (eng-sre): flipping structured_output_streaming for public... done. featurectl returned success id 20314. fallback format set to text.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: configuration change applied on 12 hosts in eu-west-1 (change id 9923).

incident-bot: current post-change metrics: fncall error rate reduced ~60%, 90th token latency down to ~2x baseline. continuing to monitor. :thumbsup:

jess: CS note drafted and shared in #customer-notices, copy below for review:
"We're seeing intermittent delays in structured JSON responses for tool calls. To mitigate impact we've temporarily restricted structured streaming for non-enterprise customers and enabled a plain-text fallback. No action needed to continue using the API; enterprise customers are unaffected. We'll post updates here." 

mika (oncall): good. plan for next 30m: monitor error rate and latency, roll back toggles progressively if metrics stabilize. prepare a rollback runbook in case latency returns: 1) revert routing multiplier, 2) re-enable structured_output_streaming for a small canary tenant, 3) slowly open to broader tenants.

ryan (eng-sre): starting collection of heap/pid dumps from 3 worst hosts for postmortem. sending off to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-2004123456/

sam: alerting dedicated customers via DM where we saw errors. they might want adjustments; offering to open a support ticket.

mika (oncall): thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for updates. tag me with any regression. I'll schedule an incident triage in 90m and assign postmortem owners.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigation in progress. If no regression in 1h, mark as "mitigated" and start postmortem prep.

jess: noted. CS will follow up with affected customers and collect reproductions.

ryan (eng-sre): one more note — devs should avoid re-enabling structured output in client-side retries; add guard in SDKs to prefer text fallback until we confirm the memory pressure fix.

mika (oncall): adding SDK guard to mitigation checklist. final status for now: mitigations applied (throttle + structured_output disabled for public), partial customer impact, monitoring. will update with any changes. :raised_hands:
